newsitem.title: USA: Mascotech sees Q1 EPS exceeding $0.35.
newsitem.headline: Mascotech sees Q1 EPS exceeding $0.35.

text.p: Mascotech Inc said Wednesday it anticipates first quarter earnings will exceed analysts' consensus forecast of about $0.35 a share.

Richard Manoogian, chairman and chief executive, said that based on present economic trends, Mascotech will achieve record earnings per share for the full year 1997 and record sales in its core transportation-related businesses.
Manoogian gave the forecast at a conference of automotive investors in New York, the company said.

Manoogian said the company has completed a major restructuring intended to focus on its core businesses. Its goal is to achieve "significant growth" in sales and earnings in those businesses over the next several years through internal growth and acquisitions, he said.
For the year-ago first quarter MascoTech reported operating income per share of $0.16. The company's full-year 1996 earnings, fully diluted, were $0.70 per share.
MascoTech's transportation-related businesses make metalworked parts for vehicle engine and drivetrain applications and automotive aftermarket products.
